subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The eldest / prince is / the heir / of the throne.
solution: The correct answer is '**of the throne**', i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**</s
